chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu Khalid, from Abu Hamzah, who said:
"If you find a louse while you are in prayer, bury it in the pebbles."
ai.seo_question: What should one do if a louse is found on the body during prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* addresses the practical jurisprudence of minor impurities (*najāsah khafīfah*) during prayer, specifically distinguishing between crushing a louse (which releases blood) and burying it whole. By instructing the worshipper to 'bury it in the pebbles,' the narration emphasizes preserving the ritual purity of the prayer space without the distraction of crushing, reflecting the Shia scholarly focus on minimizing disruptions (*mubtilat*) while maintaining the sanctity of the act of worship.
